newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria off lows, results meet estimates.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria off lows, results meet estimates.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Argentaria were weaker but off earlier lows on Friday after the bank announced 1996 results which analysts and traders said met forecasts.
At 1155 GMT Argentaria was down 50 pesetas, 0.67 percent, to 5,760 while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares was off 1.64 percent to 5,361.60.
The bank announced a 57.9 percent fall in 1996 attributable profit to 31.22 billion pesetas, with net interest income dropping to 196.77 billion from 207.20 billion in 1995.
"Results are very much in line with what we expected. People have been forecasting a poor set of figures since last year and that's in the price," said a dealer at a foreign brokerage.
For this reason the stock may well be close to a low.

"It's been really punished since December, when they announced the restructuring. But I think the stock could be ripe for a bit of a come-back now, unless of course there's further fallout from the United States (stock market)," he added.
Late last year Argentaria announced that it would use 42 billion pesetas of its 1996 profit to cut the average cost of its liabilities, aiming to increase net interest income in future years.
Analysts had forecast 1996 net profit in a range of 29.10-34.07 billion pesetas.
